threat_model.threat_source: A state with sufficiently advanced AI systems; AI-enhanced security apparatus
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Make effective protest increasingly difficult; predict and shut down civil unrest before it can exert meaningful pressure on institutional behavior
threat_model.capability: Enable surveillance on much larger, more pervasive and more accurate scale; increasingly capable autonomous military units; ability to predict and shut down civil unrest
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: The human population's ability to engage in effective protest and civil unrest as a check on state power; institutional behavior responsive to popular will

evidence.threat_source: A state with sufficiently advanced AI systems might be able to predict and shut down civil unrest before it can exert meaningful pressure on institutional behavior. ... an AI-enhanced security apparatus could make effective protest increasingly difficult.
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: an AI-enhanced security apparatus could make effective protest increasingly difficult. A state with sufficiently advanced AI systems might be able to predict and shut down civil unrest before it can exert meaningful pressure on institutional behavior.
evidence.capability: it is likely to enable surveillance on much larger, more pervasive and more accurate scale, as well as increasingly capable autonomous military units. ... A state with sufficiently advanced AI systems might be able to predict and shut down civil unrest
evidence.access: AI systems have the potential to massively automate the security apparatus and confer more power to the government
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: A state with sufficiently advanced AI systems
evidence.target_or_asset_at_risk: the human population has historically retained revolution as a last resort. The implicit threat of protests and civil unrest serves as a check on state power, forcing responsiveness to popular will. ... before it can exert meaningful pressure on institutional behavior.
